class.name: VoxelSceneData
class.brief_description: Fixed-size voxel block volume used by [VoxelScene].
class.description: Stores a [member size] of [code]uint16[/code] block IDs in row-major order [code](y, z, x)[/code]. Used as the data source of a [VoxelScene] node. Can be saved either as the compact RLE-compressed binary [code].voxscene[/code] format or as a regular Godot [code].tres[/code] resource.

method.name: get_block
method.description: Returns the block ID at the given cell, or 0 if out of bounds.

method.name: set_block
method.description: Sets the block ID at the given cell. Emits [signal Resource.changed].

method.name: fill
method.description: Fills the entire volume with [param block_id].

method.name: in_bounds
method.description: Returns whether the given cell is within bounds.

members.member: Volume size in cells. Resizing preserves overlapping cells; new cells are filled with air.
